schema_note: Modern free-to-read English editions, not restricted to 1930. Two buckets: train_ok = online, may train, do not ship in a published dataset; redistribute = US PD or CC0/BY/BY-SA only. Free PDF + all rights reserved is train_ok. Do not fetch these files into pd-english. CC-BY-NC is train_ok, not dataset-publish. Book-scale CC-BY Classical Arabic→English is still empty as of 2026-08-16.
